Growith is an app designed to help content creators refine their video content through real time feedback from a community of fellow creators. We know how challenging it can be to figure out what’s working and what’s not, so we built Growith to shorten the learning curve and accelerate your success. 🚀 Key Features: -Real-Time Feedback: Upload 1, 2 or 3 videos and set up predefined and personalized written questions to get targeted feedback from other creators. This helps you understand how your content resonates with viewers. -Earn More Test Slots: You get 3 video tests for free each month. But by providing [...] You get 3 video tests for free each month. But by providing useful feedback to others, you can earn more test slots without spending a dime. -Monetized Feedback Option: Prefer to skip the wait? You can also pay for additional feedback slots, ensuring you get the insights you need when you need them. -Closed Group Feedback: Share your content with a private community and receive feedback only from the people you give access to, whether it's your organization or a group of selected individuals.
